definitions.name: U3A.ARGMAX
definitions.note: Vector of numbers -> index of its largest element, the first one on ties

definitions.name: U3A.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES U3A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Record of numbers -> key with the largest value, the first in key order on ties

definitions.name: U3A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ 'JW' BIND ' ' JW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of space-free Strings -> one String joined by single spaces ('' for empty)

definitions.name: U3A.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'TC' BIND TC 0 GET UPPER TC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case

definitions.name: U3A.DELTAS
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'BC' BIND -1 1 '([' BC SEARCH NIL? SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 per opening and -1 per closing bracket

definitions.name: U3A.RSTEP
definitions.body: 'BE' BIND 'BA' BIND BA -1 GET BE 2 COLLECT JOIN 'BP' BIND BA -1 DROP BA BE 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 '() []' BP SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT GET
definitions.note: bracket stack (Vector of chars, bottom sentinel '#'), char -> stack after pushing the char or popping its matching opener

definitions.name: U3A.REDUCE
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of the chars left after deleting matched pairs () and [] repeatedly

definitions.name: U3A.BYNAME
definitions.body: ZIP 'LZ' BIND LZ 0 GET LZ 1 GET U2A.GSUM
definitions.note: Vector of [ key amount ] pairs -> Record from each key to the sum of its amounts, first-appearance order

definitions.name: U3A.RLESTEP
definitions.body: 'RX' BIND 'RA' BIND RA -1 GET 'RL' BIND RA -1 DROP RL 0 GET RL 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT RA RX 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RL 0 GET RX EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of [ value count ] runs, next value -> runs with the value counted in

definitions.name: U3A.RLE
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV 1 DROP RV 0 GET 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ U3A.RLESTEP ] FOLD
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> run-length encoding as Vector of [ value count ]

definitions.name: U3A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MT' BIND MT LENGTH 'MN' BIND MT MN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MT MN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of numbers -> median (mean of the two middle values when even)

definitions.name: U3A.ABS
definitions.note: number or Vector of numbers -> absolute value, lane by lane

solutions.brackets.depth: U3A.DELTAS 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: 'BS' BIND BS CHARS [ '#' ] [ U3A.RSTEP ] SCAN [ LENGTH ] MAP 'BL' BIND [ 1 ] BL CONCAT 2 LT 'BM' BIND 0 BS CHARS LENGTH RANGE 0 BM SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.ledger.debtors: U3A.BYNAME 'LR' BIND LR KEYS [ 'LK' BIND LR LK GET 0 LT ] FILTER
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LE' BIND LE LE ZIP 1 GET U3A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ U3A.CAP ] MAP U3A.UNWORDS
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'PW' BIND PW PW [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP U3A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.upruns: 'UV' BIND UV 1 DROP UV -1 DROP SUB 0 GT 1 [ 'UM' BIND 'UA' BIND UA 1 ADD 1 UM SELECT ] SCAN 1 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.majority: 'JV' BIND JV TALLY 'JT' BIND JT U3A.TOPKEY 'JK' BIND JK NIL 2 COLLECT 0 1 JT JK GET 2 MUL JV LENGTH GT SELECT GET
solutions.sensor.filled: 'SV' BIND SV SV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ 'SX' BIND 'SA' BIND SA SX SX NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ NIL? ] MAP 'GM' BIND 1 0 GM FALSE 1 COLLECT GM -1 DROP CONCAT NOT AND SELECT G0A.SUM
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ NIL? ] MAP 0 [ 'GX' BIND 'GA' BIND GA 1 ADD 0 GX SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'QV' BIND QV 1 DROP QV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'QX' BIND 'QA' BIND QX QX QA 0 GET DIV 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'CV' BIND CV [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 'CP' BIND CP CP 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'CM' BIND CV [ CM DIV ] MAP
solutions.series.mad: 'AV' BIND AV AV U3A.MEDIAN SUB U3A.ABS U3A.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'WV' BIND WV -2 DROP WV 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD WV 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'XV' BIND XV XV 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
